sections.heading: THE REALITY
sections.body: A directory of links is only useful when every destination has a clear reason to exist. If a service is still planned or awaiting its production hostname, the directory must explain that status and offer a real current alternative rather than a dead link.

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
